# Insight Enterprises (NSIT) Q3 2026 Earnings Call: EPS Rises 34%, Outlook Raised
Insight Enterprises reported robust Q3 2026 financial results, with net revenue rising 22% year over year to $2.4 billion and adjusted diluted EPS growing 34% to $3.59. Growth was propelled by a 32% increase in hardware revenue and a 26% rise in cloud gross profit, supported by AI infrastructure demand and Microsoft-related sales.
Buoyed by this momentum, management raised its full-year gross profit growth guidance to 12.5%-14% and adjusted diluted EPS outlook to $13.55-$13.75. However, executives adopted a prudent stance for Q4, citing moderating growth, Google Partner Program changes, and macroeconomic uncertainties regarding supply chains and memory pricing.
## Key Takeaways
- Net revenue increased 22% year over year to $2.4 billion, driven by hardware and services growth, partly offset by lower on-premises software revenue.
- Adjusted diluted EPS rose 34% to $3.59, while adjusted EBITDA increased 22% to $177 million.
- Hardware revenue grew 32%. Management cited growth of more than 50% in infrastructure and more than 30% in devices, supported by AI-related modernization and market-share gains.
- Cloud gross profit increased 26% to $164 million, led by SaaS, Microsoft-related demand and security software from the Sekuro acquisition.
- Management raised its 2026 gross profit growth outlook to 12.5%-14% and adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $13.55-$13.75, excluding stock-based compensation.
- Insight expects approximately $30 million in annualized gross savings from its voluntary separation program and remains committed to reducing SG&A as a percentage of gross profit over time.

## Summary

Insight Enterprises reported third-quarter 2026 results that exceeded expectations, with net revenue of $2.4 billion, up 22% year-over-year in both USD and constant currency. Gross profit rose 20% to $514 million, while adjusted earnings from operations grew 23% and adjusted diluted EPS jumped 34% to $3.59 (36% in constant currency).
